name: Tashiro Masaki
source: A world renowned painter based in Kodachi, Japan. He's most famous for his abstract pieces which have gained critical acclaim over the years. Other than being an artist, Tashiro is the father to Tashiro Masaki Jr. also known as Tai Masaki. Tashiro is the typical arrogant artisan who revels in praise of professionals and amateurs alike. He knows just how great he is and adores making people feel smaller than him.
